name: base-blocked-unlock-pickup
task: Pick up the blocking ball and the key, in either order, unlock the door, and then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: R3, hard Existence(door_open), is redundant: the hard Existence(target_picked_up) with Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) already forces door_open. Remove R3; keep the stated order clauses.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The two hard Precedence clauses require the blocker and matching key before the door opens; the hard Existence requires the box pickup, and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) orders it after the door opens. These clauses match the task without redundant Existence clauses.

texts: Pick up the blocking ball and acquire the matching key, in either order, before unlocking the door.
Acquire the matching key before unlocking the door.
Pick up the box after unlocking the door.
Unlock the door before picking up the box.
